description.value: For the duration, once per round, when an ally within 15 feet of one of your Afflicted would be hit by a Strike, that Afflicted interposes and the Strike hits it instead.

cinderfall.incomplete: This clause is an ongoing effect targeting a different creature's roll/HP/condition/behavior, sourced from the holder's own passive (P-CROSSCREATURE), with no selector anywhere in pf2e-source for one actor's rule element to reach into a separate actor on an ongoing basis. Searched Champion reaction abilities (Liberating Step, Retributive Strike) and companion/eidolon protection feats for a "redirect an incoming Strike to a third creature" mechanic; the closest analogs only add or reduce damage after the attack roll resolves, none intercept the attack roll itself onto a different creature. No selector exists for this.
